description.p: BiGame-mode is the gaming centre of BigLinux. Turbo switches falcond on, so every game gets its performance profile, applied when it starts and undone when it closes. BiGame-mode shows what is really in effect, measures whether a change helped, and manages upscaling and frame generation inside games, with full backup and undo.

ul.li: Turbo: one switch for per-game optimization through falcond
Profiles for Steam, Lutris, Heroic and native games, offered when an unknown game starts
AI Graphics: OptiScaler installed with verified backups, repair and restore
Measure the difference: repeated A/B runs with a statistical verdict
Real-time telemetry, diagnostics and one view of every relevant log
Stays in the tray when the window is closed

description.p: Six pages, with Details showing what is really in effect and the evidence for it; AI Graphics raises FSR 3.1 to FSR 4 through Proton and finds the upscalers Unreal Engine games ship as plugins; MangoHud per game for Steam, Heroic and Lutris; the Gamer theme; every text translated into 29 languages; a stricter sandbox for the privileged helper.

Turbo as the master switch over falcond, per-game profiles offered when an unknown game starts, AI Graphics with OptiScaler (backup, repair and restore), a benchmark lab with A/B verdicts, diagnostics and a unified log view.
Initial release with dashboard, profiles, tuning, and gamescope panels.
